# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggVennDiagram)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
wd_mirna  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/cohort7_miRNAs"
wd_mrna   <- "F:/wd/Mm_Bulk_RNA-seq"
dir_ref   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/ref"

tissues   <- c("hypo", "liver", "panc", "gut", "ewat", "iwat", "bat", "gas", "sol")
timepoints <- c("0d", "1d", "3d", "1w", "2w", "4w", "6w", "8w", "10w", "12w")

# Time axis in days (for scaling and plotting)
time_days <- c(0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 28, 42, 56, 70, 84)

# Cosine similarity threshold for negative correlation
COS_THRESHOLD <- -0.6

# This analysis uses the UNION of miRDB and TargetScan predictions only.
# No database score filter is applied (the intersection branch has been removed).
PAIR_SET <- "union"

date_str   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir_output <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "02.0.2_integration_union", date_str)
dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", dir_output, "\n")
```

# 3. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Return the latest maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3 directory for a given tissue (mRNA)
find_masigpro_dir <- function(tissue) {
  base      <- file.path(wd_mrna, "output", tissue)
  all_dated <- list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  all_dated <- all_dated[grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", basename(all_dated))]
  all_dated <- sort(all_dated, decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in all_dated) {
    cand <- file.path(d, "maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3")
    if (dir.exists(cand)) return(cand)
  }
  stop(paste("maSigPro_rsq0.7_d3 not found:", tissue))
}

# Return the latest miRNA maSigPro output directory
find_mirna_masigpro_dir <- function() {
  base      <- file.path(wd_mirna, "output", "01_maSigPro")
  all_dated <- sort(list.dirs(base, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE),
                    decreasing = TRUE)
  for (d in all_dated) {
    if (length(list.files(d, pattern = "^Plasma_miRNA_ids_clst_")) > 0) return(d)
  }
  stop("miRNA maSigPro output not found")
}

# Compute cosine similarity between two numeric vectors
cosine_sim <- function(x, y) {
  if (any(is.na(x)) || any(is.na(y))) return(NA_real_)
  denom <- sqrt(sum(x^2)) * sqrt(sum(y^2))
  if (denom == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x * y) / denom
}
```

# 4. Load miRNA cluster data

```{r load_mirna_clusters}
dir_mirna_ms <- find_mirna_masigpro_dir()
cat("Using miRNA maSigPro dir:", dir_mirna_ms, "\n")

# Load all cluster CSVs and bind
mirna_clst_df <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  f <- file.path(dir_mirna_ms, paste0("Plasma_miRNA_ids_clst_", i, ".csv"))
  read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}) %>% bind_rows()

detected_miRNAs <- unique(mirna_clst_df$miRNA_Name)
cat("Detected miRNAs (maSigPro clusters 1-5):", length(detected_miRNAs), "\n")
print(table(mirna_clst_df$cluster))
```

# 5. Load DEG mRNA lists (per tissue)

```{r load_deg_mrna}
deg_mrna <- setNames(
  lapply(tissues, function(tis) {
    dir_ms <- tryCatch(find_masigpro_dir(tis), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(dir_ms)) { cat("Skipped:", tis, "\n"); return(NULL) }
    f <- file.path(dir_ms,
                   paste0(tis, "_maSigPro_mRNA_rsq0.70_hclust.k4.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) { cat("CSV not found:", tis, "\n"); return(NULL) }
    df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    # Handle both row-name and named gene column
    if ("gene" %in% colnames(df)) df$gene else df$X
  }),
  tissues
)

deg_mrna <- Filter(Negate(is.null), deg_mrna)
all_deg_symbols <- unique(unlist(deg_mrna))

cat("Tissues loaded:", length(deg_mrna), "\n")
cat("Total unique DEG symbols:", length(all_deg_symbols), "\n")
```

# 6. Build miRDB pairs

```{r miRDB_pairs}
# Load miRDB and filter to detected miRNAs
miRDB_raw <- read_tsv(
  file.path(dir_ref, "miRDB_v6.0_prediction_result.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(miRNA_Name %in% detected_miRNAs)

cat("miRDB entries for detected miRNAs:", nrow(miRDB_raw), "\n")

# Convert REFSEQ -> SYMBOL
refseq_to_symbol <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys    = unique(miRDB_raw$REFSEQ),
  columns = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "REFSEQ"
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct(REFSEQ, SYMBOL)

miRDB_base <- miRDB_raw %>%
  left_join(refseq_to_symbol, by = "REFSEQ") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL %in% all_deg_symbols)

# All pairs (no score filter) — union basis
miRDB_pairs_all <- miRDB_base %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL) %>%
  mutate(pair_id = paste(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL, sep = "__"))

cat("miRDB pairs (all):", nrow(miRDB_pairs_all), "\n")
```

# 7. Build TargetScan pairs

```{r TargetScan_pairs}

ts_scores <- read_tsv(
  file.path(dir_ref, "TargetScan_v8.0/mouse/Predicted_Targets_Context_Scores_mmu.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

ts_base <- ts_scores %>%
  filter(miRNA %in% detected_miRNAs,
         `Gene Symbol` %in% all_deg_symbols)

# All pairs (no score filter) — union basis
TargetScan_pairs_all <- ts_base %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name = miRNA, SYMBOL = `Gene Symbol`) %>%
  mutate(pair_id = paste(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL, sep = "__"))

cat("TargetScan pairs (all):", nrow(TargetScan_pairs_all), "\n")
```

# 9. Pair set: union

```{r pair_sets}
# Union of miRDB and TargetScan predictions (no score filter on either database)
union_pair_ids <- union(miRDB_pairs_all$pair_id, TargetScan_pairs_all$pair_id)
cat("Union pairs (no filter):", length(union_pair_ids), "\n")

union_pairs <- bind_rows(miRDB_pairs_all, TargetScan_pairs_all) %>%
  filter(pair_id %in% union_pair_ids) %>%
  distinct(miRNA_Name, SYMBOL)

# Expand the pair set by tissue
union_pairs_tissue <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(deg_mrna), function(tis) {
    union_pairs %>%
      filter(SYMBOL %in% deg_mrna[[tis]]) %>%
      mutate(tissue = tis)
  })
)

cat("Pairs × tissue (before cosine filter):", nrow(union_pairs_tissue), "\n")
```

# 10. Scale expression profiles

## 10.1 miRNA: scaled log2(1+TPM) per timepoint

```{r scale_mirna}
# Load raw miRNA matrix
data_miRNA_raw <- read.csv(
  file.path(wd_mirna, "output/data.clean_matrix.csv"),
  header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "miR")

# Outlier samples to exclude
outlier_samples <- c("1wk_201", "3d_206", "6wk_174", "8wk_234")

mirna_long <- data_miRNA_raw %>%
  rownames_to_column("miRNA_Name") %>%
  pivot_longer(-miRNA_Name, names_to = "sample.ID", values_to = "TPM") %>%
  filter(!sample.ID %in% outlier_samples) %>%
  mutate(
    tp_raw  = sub("^(\\w+)_.*", "\\1", sample.ID),
    # Normalise "1wk","2wk"... -> "1w","2w"... to match mRNA timepoint labels
    tp_norm = sub("wk$", "w", tp_raw),
    timepoint = factor(tp_norm, levels = timepoints),
    log2tpm = log2(1 + TPM)
  )

# Median per miRNA × timepoint, then scale across timepoints
mirna_avg <- mirna_long %>%
  filter(miRNA_Name %in% detected_miRNAs) %>%
  group_by(miRNA_Name, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(med = median(log2tpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = med) %>%
  column_to_rownames("miRNA_Name")

# Scale each miRNA profile (z-score across timepoints)
mirna_scaled <- t(scale(t(mirna_avg), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
mirna_scaled[is.na(mirna_scaled)] <- 0

cat("Scaled miRNA matrix:", nrow(mirna_scaled), "miRNAs x",
    ncol(mirna_scaled), "timepoints\n")
```

## 10.2 mRNA: scaled Log2TPM per tissue

```{r scale_mrna}
mrna_scaled <- setNames(
  lapply(tissues, function(tis) {
    dir_ms <- tryCatch(find_masigpro_dir(tis), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(dir_ms)) return(NULL)

    # nonzero_Log2TPM.csv is in the dated parent directory
    dir_parent <- dirname(dir_ms)
    f <- file.path(dir_parent, paste0(tis, "_nonzero_Log2TPM.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)

    df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      filter(symbol %in% deg_mrna[[tis]])

    # Timepoint label normalisation (1w/2w... -> 1w/2w...)
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        tp_clean = sub(paste0("^", tis, "_"), "", sample.ID),
        tp_clean = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", tp_clean),
        tp_clean = factor(tp_clean, levels = timepoints)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(tp_clean))

    # Median per symbol × timepoint
    avg <- df %>%
      group_by(symbol, tp_clean) %>%
      summarise(med = median(Log2TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = tp_clean, values_from = med) %>%
      column_to_rownames("symbol")

    # Keep only timepoints present in data
    avg <- avg[, colSums(!is.na(avg)) == nrow(avg), drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(avg) < 2) return(NULL)

    scaled <- t(scale(t(avg), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
    scaled[is.na(scaled)] <- 0
    scaled
  }),
  tissues
)

mrna_scaled <- Filter(Negate(is.null), mrna_scaled)
cat("Tissues with scaled mRNA:", paste(names(mrna_scaled), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 11. Cosine similarity

```{r cosine_similarity}
# Compute cosine similarity for a pairs-tissue data frame
compute_cosine <- function(pairs_tissue_df) {
  pairs_tissue_df %>%
    filter(tissue %in% names(mrna_scaled)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      cosine = {
        mir  <- miRNA_Name
        gene <- SYMBOL
        tis  <- tissue

        if (!(mir  %in% rownames(mirna_scaled)) ||
            !(gene %in% rownames(mrna_scaled[[tis]]))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          tp_common <- intersect(colnames(mirna_scaled),
                                 colnames(mrna_scaled[[tis]]))
          if (length(tp_common) < 3) {
            NA_real_
          } else {
            cosine_sim(
              as.numeric(mirna_scaled[mir,  tp_common]),
              as.numeric(mrna_scaled[[tis]][gene, tp_common])
            )
          }
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

cos_result <- compute_cosine(union_pairs_tissue)

cat("Pairs with cosine computed:", sum(!is.na(cos_result$cosine)), "\n")
cat("\nCosine distribution — union:\n")
print(summary(cos_result$cosine))
```

# 12. Filter: cosine < -0.6

```{r filter_negative}
neg_df <- cos_result %>%
  filter(!is.na(cosine), cosine < COS_THRESHOLD) %>%
  left_join(mirna_clst_df %>% distinct(miRNA_Name, cluster),
            by = "miRNA_Name") %>%
  dplyr::rename(miRNA_cluster = cluster) %>%
  mutate(pair_set = PAIR_SET) %>%
  arrange(cosine)

cat("Negative pairs (cosine <", COS_THRESHOLD, "):", nrow(neg_df), "\n")
cat("Breakdown by tissue:\n")
print(table(neg_df$tissue))
cat("Breakdown by miRNA cluster:\n")
print(table(neg_df$miRNA_cluster))

dir_set <- file.path(dir_output, PAIR_SET)
dir.create(dir_set, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  neg_df,
  file.path(dir_set, paste0("negative_cosine_pairs_", PAIR_SET, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat("Saved: ", PAIR_SET, "/negative_cosine_pairs_", PAIR_SET, ".csv\n", sep = "")
```

# 13. Expression dynamics plots

```{r prep_long_data}
# Build scaled long-format tables for plotting

# Lookup table: timepoint label -> days (0-84)
tp_to_days <- setNames(time_days, timepoints)
# e.g. tp_to_days["1w"] = 7, tp_to_days["12w"] = 84

# miRNA long (scaled) — timepoints already normalised to match `timepoints` vector
mirna_scaled_long <- as.data.frame(mirna_scaled) %>%
  rownames_to_column("miRNA_Name") %>%
  pivot_longer(-miRNA_Name, names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "scaled") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoints),
    time_days = tp_to_days[as.character(timepoint)]   # rescale to 0-84 days
  )

# mRNA long (scaled), per tissue
mrna_scaled_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mrna_scaled), function(tis) {
    as.data.frame(mrna_scaled[[tis]]) %>%
      rownames_to_column("SYMBOL") %>%
      pivot_longer(-SYMBOL, names_to = "timepoint", values_to = "scaled") %>%
      mutate(
        tissue    = tis,
        timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = timepoints),
        time_days = tp_to_days[as.character(timepoint)]   # rescale to 0-84 days
      )
  })
)
```

```{r dynamics_helper}
# Color constants
# Individual lines: desaturated (low saturation) to not compete with fitted curves
COL_MIRNA_LINE   <- "#d9909a"   # muted pink  — individual miRNA lines
COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH <- "#d32047"   # vivid red   — miRNA LOESS fitted curve
COL_MRNA_LINE    <- "#8ab4cc"   # muted steel blue — individual mRNA lines
COL_MRNA_SMOOTH  <- "#2166ac"   # vivid blue  — mRNA LOESS fitted curve

# Shared plotting function
# plot_df must have columns: SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type (miRNA / mRNA)
make_dynamics_plot <- function(plot_df, title_str, subtitle_str, group_var = "SYMBOL") {
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = time_days, y = scaled, group = .data[[group_var]])) +
    # mRNA individual lines — muted blue, fixed color (not from aes)
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
              color = COL_MRNA_LINE,
              alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.45) +
    # mRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid blue
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#c6dbef",
                linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    # miRNA individual lines — muted pink, fixed color (not from aes)
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
              color = COL_MIRNA_LINE,
              linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    # miRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid red
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#fcc5c0",
                linewidth = 1.4) +
    # Manual legend: show fitted curve colors only
    scale_color_manual(
      name   = NULL,
      values = c("miRNA (fitted)" = COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH,
                 "mRNA (fitted)"  = COL_MRNA_SMOOTH),
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = time_days,          # x-axis: 0-84 days
      labels = timepoints          # labels: "0d","1d",...,"12w"
    ) +
    labs(title    = title_str,
         subtitle = subtitle_str,
         x = "Duration of HFD feeding (days)",
         y = "Scaled expression (z-score)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r stacked_helper}
# Row labels of the 2 x 5 matrix.
# Kept short because they are rendered in the rotated right-hand strip.
PANEL_MIRNA <- "Plasma miRNA"
PANEL_MRNA  <- "Target mRNA (pooled)"

# Cluster columns are fixed at 1-5 so the layout stays a 2 x 5 matrix even if a
# cluster carries no negative pair (facet_grid(drop = FALSE) keeps it empty)
CLUSTER_LEVELS <- paste("Cluster", 1:5)

# 2 (row: miRNA / pooled target mRNA) x 5 (column: miRNA cluster) matrix.
# facet_grid is used instead of stitching separate plots together so that every
# panel shares one identical time axis and one identical y scale.
# stack_df must have columns:
#   line_id, time_days, scaled, type, panel, cluster_label
make_stacked_matrix_plot <- function(stack_df, title_str, subtitle_str) {

  ggplot(stack_df, aes(x = time_days, y = scaled, group = line_id)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey65") +
    # mRNA individual lines — muted blue (drawn only in the mRNA row)
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
              color = COL_MRNA_LINE,
              alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.45) +
    # mRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid blue
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#c6dbef",
                linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    # miRNA individual lines — muted pink (drawn only in the miRNA row)
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
              color = COL_MIRNA_LINE,
              linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    # miRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid red
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#fcc5c0",
                linewidth = 1.4) +
    # Rows = expression type, columns = miRNA cluster.
    # All scales are shared, so the timepoints line up across every panel.
    facet_grid(panel ~ cluster_label, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_days, labels = timepoints) +
    labs(title    = title_str,
         subtitle = subtitle_str,
         x = "Duration of HFD feeding (days)",
         y = "Scaled expression (z-score)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio     = 1,           # square panels
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y     = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
}
```

```{r dynamics_plots, results='asis', fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
mir_clusters <- sort(unique(neg_df$miRNA_cluster))

for (clst in mir_clusters) {

  cat("\n\n## miRNA Cluster", clst, "\n\n")

  pairs_clst <- neg_df %>% filter(miRNA_cluster == clst)
  mirs_clst  <- unique(pairs_clst$miRNA_Name)

  # ---- miRNA expression (shared across sub-sections) ----
  mirna_df_base <- mirna_scaled_long %>%
    filter(miRNA_Name %in% mirs_clst) %>%
    dplyr::rename(SYMBOL = miRNA_Name) %>%
    mutate(type = "miRNA")

  # ================================================================
  # 13a. Per-tissue plots
  # ================================================================
  for (tis in sort(unique(pairs_clst$tissue))) {

    cat("\n### ", tis, "\n\n", sep = "")

    pairs_tis <- pairs_clst %>% filter(tissue == tis)

    mrna_df <- mrna_scaled_long %>%
      filter(tissue == tis, SYMBOL %in% pairs_tis$SYMBOL) %>%
      mutate(type = "mRNA")

    plot_df <- bind_rows(
      mirna_df_base %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type),
      mrna_df       %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type)
    )

    p <- make_dynamics_plot(
      plot_df,
      title_str    = paste0("Cluster ", clst, " miRNA vs mRNA — ", tis),
      subtitle_str = paste0("n = ", n_distinct(pairs_tis$SYMBOL),
                            " mRNA pairs | cosine < ", COS_THRESHOLD)
    )

    print(p)

    svg_out <- file.path(dir_set,
                         paste0("dynamics_", PAIR_SET,
                                "_clst", clst, "_", tis, ".svg"))
    svg(svg_out, width = 10, height = 5); print(p); dev.off()
  }

  # ================================================================
  # 13b. Cross-tissue combined plot (faceted by tissue)
  # ================================================================
  cat("\n### All tissues (combined)\n\n")

  mrna_df_all <- mrna_scaled_long %>%
    filter(
      tissue %in% unique(pairs_clst$tissue),
      SYMBOL %in% unique(pairs_clst$SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    # Keep only (tissue, SYMBOL) pairs that are in neg_df
    semi_join(pairs_clst %>% dplyr::select(tissue, SYMBOL),
              by = c("tissue", "SYMBOL")) %>%
    mutate(type = "mRNA")

  # Replicate miRNA lines into each tissue panel
  mirna_df_rep <- bind_rows(
    lapply(sort(unique(pairs_clst$tissue)), function(tis) {
      mirna_df_base %>% mutate(tissue = tis)
    })
  )

  plot_df_all <- bind_rows(
    mirna_df_rep %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type, tissue),
    mrna_df_all  %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type, tissue)
  )

  n_tis_facet <- n_distinct(plot_df_all$tissue)

  p_all <- ggplot(plot_df_all,
                  aes(x = time_days, y = scaled, group = SYMBOL)) +
    # mRNA individual lines — muted blue, fixed color
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
              color = COL_MRNA_LINE,
              alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.45) +
    # mRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid blue
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "mRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#c6dbef",
                linewidth = 1.0, linetype = "dashed") +
    # miRNA individual lines — muted pink, fixed color
    geom_line(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
              color = COL_MIRNA_LINE,
              linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    # miRNA LOESS fitted curve — vivid red
    geom_smooth(data = ~filter(., type == "miRNA"),
                aes(group = 1),
                method = "loess", se = TRUE,
                color = COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH, fill = "#fcc5c0",
                linewidth = 1.1) +
    # Manual legend: show fitted curve colors only
    scale_color_manual(
      name   = NULL,
      values = c("miRNA (fitted)" = COL_MIRNA_SMOOTH,
                 "mRNA (fitted)"  = COL_MRNA_SMOOTH),
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_days, labels = timepoints) +
    facet_wrap(~ tissue, nrow = 2) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Cluster ", clst, " miRNA vs mRNA — all tissues"),
      subtitle = paste0("cosine < ", COS_THRESHOLD,
                        " | n tissues = ", n_tis_facet),
      x = "Duration of HFD feeding (days)",
      y = "Scaled expression (z-score)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p_all)

  svg_out_all <- file.path(dir_set,
                           paste0("dynamics_", PAIR_SET,
                                  "_clst", clst, "_all_tissues.svg"))
  svg(svg_out_all,
      width  = 4 * min(n_tis_facet, 5),
      height = 4 * ceiling(n_tis_facet / 5))
  print(p_all)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", basename(svg_out_all), "\n\n")

  # ================================================================
  # 13c. All tissues pooled — single panel, no tissue distinction
  # ================================================================
  cat("\n### All tissues pooled (no tissue distinction)\n\n")

  # Pool all mRNA from all tissues — each tissue-gene pair is an independent line
  mrna_df_pool <- mrna_scaled_long %>%
    filter(
      tissue %in% unique(pairs_clst$tissue),
      SYMBOL %in% unique(pairs_clst$SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    semi_join(pairs_clst %>% dplyr::select(tissue, SYMBOL),
              by = c("tissue", "SYMBOL")) %>%
    mutate(
      type       = "mRNA",
      tissue_gene = paste(tissue, SYMBOL, sep = "-")  # unique id per tissue-gene pair
    )

  n_pairs <- n_distinct(mrna_df_pool$tissue_gene)   # number of lines (tissue × gene)
  n_genes <- n_distinct(mrna_df_pool$SYMBOL)        # number of unique genes

  plot_df_pool <- bind_rows(
    mirna_df_base %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type) %>%
      mutate(tissue_gene = SYMBOL),
    mrna_df_pool  %>% dplyr::select(tissue_gene, SYMBOL, time_days, scaled, type)
  )

  p_pool <- make_dynamics_plot(
    plot_df_pool,
    title_str    = paste0("Cluster ", clst, " miRNA vs mRNA — all tissues pooled"),
    subtitle_str = paste0(
      "lines (tissue-gene pairs) = ", n_pairs, " | ",
      "unique genes = ", n_genes, " | ",
      "n tissues = ", n_distinct(mrna_df_pool$tissue), " | ",
      "cosine < ", COS_THRESHOLD
    ),
    group_var = "tissue_gene"
  )

  print(p_pool)

  svg_out_pool <- file.path(dir_set,
                            paste0("dynamics_", PAIR_SET,
                                   "_clst", clst, "_pooled.svg"))
  svg(svg_out_pool, width = 10, height = 5)
  print(p_pool)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", basename(svg_out_pool), "\n\n")

}  # end cluster loop
```

# 14. Matrix layout: negatively correlated miRNAs over pooled target mRNAs

A single 2 x 5 matrix of square panels. Top row: the negatively correlated
miRNAs of each cluster. Bottom row: their target mRNAs pooled across all
tissues. Columns are miRNA clusters 1-5, so every column is one
miRNA / target pair sharing the same time axis.

```{r stacked_plots, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=18}
# Build one long table covering every cluster, tagged with its row (panel) and
# column (cluster_label) position in the 2 x 5 matrix
stack_df <- bind_rows(lapply(mir_clusters, function(clst) {

  pairs_clst <- neg_df %>% filter(miRNA_cluster == clst)
  mirs_clst  <- unique(pairs_clst$miRNA_Name)

  # ---- Top row: miRNAs of this cluster that carry a negative pair ----
  mirna_df_stack <- mirna_scaled_long %>%
    filter(miRNA_Name %in% mirs_clst) %>%
    mutate(
      type    = "miRNA",
      panel   = PANEL_MIRNA,
      SYMBOL  = miRNA_Name,
      tissue  = NA_character_,
      # Prefix with the cluster so line ids stay unique across columns
      line_id = paste0("c", clst, "_", miRNA_Name)
    )

  # ---- Bottom row: target mRNAs pooled across all tissues ----
  # Each (tissue, gene) combination is kept as an independent line
  mrna_df_stack <- mrna_scaled_long %>%
    filter(
      tissue %in% unique(pairs_clst$tissue),
      SYMBOL %in% unique(pairs_clst$SYMBOL)
    ) %>%
    semi_join(pairs_clst %>% dplyr::select(tissue, SYMBOL),
              by = c("tissue", "SYMBOL")) %>%
    mutate(
      type    = "mRNA",
      panel   = PANEL_MRNA,
      line_id = paste0("c", clst, "_", tissue, "-", SYMBOL)
    )

  bind_rows(
    mirna_df_stack %>%
      dplyr::select(line_id, SYMBOL, tissue, time_days, scaled, type, panel),
    mrna_df_stack %>%
      dplyr::select(line_id, SYMBOL, tissue, time_days, scaled, type, panel)
  ) %>%
    mutate(cluster_label = paste("Cluster", clst))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    panel         = factor(panel, levels = c(PANEL_MIRNA, PANEL_MRNA)),
    cluster_label = factor(cluster_label, levels = CLUSTER_LEVELS)
  )

# Number of lines drawn in each panel of the matrix
stack_summary <- stack_df %>%
  group_by(cluster_label, panel) %>%
  summarise(n_lines = n_distinct(line_id),
            n_genes = n_distinct(SYMBOL),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("\nLines per panel:\n")
print(as.data.frame(stack_summary))

p_matrix <- make_stacked_matrix_plot(
  stack_df,
  title_str    = "Negatively correlated miRNAs and their pooled target mRNAs",
  subtitle_str = paste0(
    "rows: plasma miRNA / target mRNA pooled across all tissues | ",
    "columns: miRNA maSigPro cluster | ",
    "cosine < ", COS_THRESHOLD, " (", PAIR_SET, " pairs)"
  )
)

print(p_matrix)

svg_out_matrix <- file.path(
  dir_set,
  paste0("matrix_", PAIR_SET, "_miRNA_pooled_mRNA_2x5.svg")
)
svg(svg_out_matrix, width = 18, height = 8)
print(p_matrix)
dev.off()
cat("Saved:", basename(svg_out_matrix), "\n\n")
```
